scientific_limitations: Only symmetric nonnegative stochastic chains with uniform stationary distribution on the second power of a finite cycle are optimized.
No claim is made that all globally optimal, spatially inhomogeneous matrices coincide with the unique invariant optimum.
Specialized unindexed literature may contain equivalent exact finite-dimensional formulas; independent mathematical audit remains outstanding.
Numerical evidence is finite and does not replace the all-dimensional proof.
